verdict.rationale: Wise documents balance-statement export in many open and standard formats (JSON, CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF, PDF), which covers transaction history well. Card transaction and account retrieval APIs exist, but there is no documented complete-account export or offboarding path. Missing for 10: a single full-account export (recipients, cards, documents, profile data), documented account-closure/exit process, independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
